_readme: Websites for /coc/tools/ (Web Tools), shown in this order -- same card as coc-home's Clash Tools (.ct-card): the site icon, what it does (tag) as the title, one line, and the domain. icon: a local 128px favicon in clashofclans/coctools/favicons/.
_tools: The Parchrome tools box above the websites (#gdTools). Which tools, their order, names, icons and links all come from coc-nav-data.json's guides list -- the same as the Tools strip -- minus the page you're on. This only holds each one's line of text, by the guide's id.

tools.glossary: Slang and terms from clan chat and war, and what they mean.
tools.armymaker: Build an army for TH8 to TH18, then open it straight in Clash of Clans or share the link.
tools.equipments: Every hero equipment's stats at each level, the ore it costs, and how to use it.
tools.damagecalc: Pick your spells and equipment, and see what they leave of every building and hero.
tools.wallcalc: Work out what it costs to take your walls from one level to another.
